headline: Yesterday the win-back goal contacted 412 customers and 37 of them bought, for $2,960 in revenue.

sections.title: What happened
sections.body: Contacted 412 customers and left 1,688 alone. 37 bought within the day, for $2,960 in revenue. Spend was $96.

sections.title: Who we left alone and why
sections.body: 1,120 were at their weekly contact limit or had just bought, 384 looked like they buy on their own anyway, and 184 are in the no-contact holdout.

sections.title: What it is learning
sections.body: Free shipping is beating the percentage discount for lapsed coffee buyers. The share of contacts offered the discount fell from 31% to 18%.

sections.title: Watch
sections.body: No customer complaints yesterday and 3 unsubscribes. Email delivery was 98.7%.
